verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: Let the children of Israel speak, and let them settle down and take their positions before the sacred vessels, between the heights and the sea. They shall stand on the shore, in front of the Lord of the heavens.
verses.3: And Pharaoh said to the children of Israel, “The frogs are everywhere in this land. They cover everything.”
verses.4: And I strengthened Pharaoh’s heart, and I pursued after them. Pharaoh and all his army were defeated. Thus, the people of Egypt knew that I was Jehovah. And so it happened.
verses.5: And he reported to the king of Egypt that the people had rebelled, and they turned Pharaoh and his servants against them. They said, “What have we done? We sent Israel away from our service.”
verses.6: And he forbade his chariot and his people from taking it with him.
verses.7: And he took six hundred chariots, all of which were Egyptian chariots. And three thousand soldiers were also on them.
verses.8: And Jehovah strengthened the heart of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. He continued to pursue the children of Israel. The children of Israel fought with bows in their hands.
verses.9: And they pursued them from Egypt. They captured them and kept them captive on the sea. All of Pharaoh’s chariots and his army were there, ready to attack them before Baal Zebulun.
verses.10: And Pharaoh offered sacrifices. The children of Israel also laid their hands on the altar. Then they saw that Egypt was pursuing them. They were filled with fear, and they cried out to Jehovah for help.
verses.11: And they said to Moses, “There are no graves in Egypt. How can you bring us out of Egypt alive?” What have you done to us, so that you could bring us out of Egypt alive?
verses.12: This is not what we said to you in Egypt: “Stop doing this, and let us serve Egypt, for it is better for us to serve Egypt from within the land of Egypt itself.”
verses.13: And Moses said to the people, “Do not be afraid. Stand firm and see the salvation of the LORD that He will do for you today. For since you have seen Egypt today, you shall never go back there again until the end of time.”
verses.14: Yehovah will fight for you, and you shall be saved.
verses.15: And the LORD said to Moses, “Why do you cry out to me? Speak to the children of Israel and let them go.”
verses.16: And you shall raise your hand over the sea, and it will be divided in two. Then the children of Israel will come into the sea in a double line.
verses.17: And I will strengthen the hearts of the Egyptians. They will come after them, and I will be happy with Pharaoh and all his army, in their chariots and wagons.
verses.18: And the nations shall know that I, Jehovah, am in charge of Pharaoh’s chariot and his army.
verses.19: And the angel of the Lord went before the camp of Israel. He went among them, and the cloud of heaven also moved behind them. The cloud stood behind them.
verses.20: And it came between the camps of Egypt and those of Israel. There was darkness and gloominess throughout the night, and these two periods did not overlap at all.
verses.21: And Moses raised his hand over the sea. Then Jehovah crossed the sea in a mighty wind all night long. He made the sea divide into two parts, and the waters rushed apart.
verses.22: And the children of Israel came into the sea in a ship. The water was hot for them from both their right and left sides.
verses.23: And they pursued them from Egypt. All of Pharaoh’s horses and chariots came after them, and their charioteers rushed forward towards the sky.
verses.24: And in the evening, God showed the city of Egypt with a sign of fire and clouds. Then He destroyed the city of Egypt.
verses.25: And he removed the banners from his chariots, and he drove them forward with great vigor. He said, “Moses, we are defeated by Israel. For Jehovah will fight against them in Egypt.”
verses.26: And the LORD said to Moses, “Put your hand over the sea, so that the waters will cover Egypt’s ships and their crews.”
verses.27: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the sea parted before us in the morning. The people of Egypt tried to call out to him, but Jehovah made the Egyptians drown in the sea.
verses.28: And the waters receded, covering the chariots and soldiers of Pharaoh’s army. Not a single one of them remained behind.
verses.29: And the children of Israel walked in the desert across the sea. The water was hot to them from both their right and left sides.
verses.30: And the LORD saved Israel from the hands of the Egyptians on that day. And Israel saw Egypt from above the waters.
verses.31: And Israel saw the great hand that Jehovah had done in Egypt. The people feared Jehovah, and they believed in Jehovah and in Moses, their servant.
